title: Returning part of a string without copying it

concepts.description: A returned reference must be tied to an input's lifetime, because it cannot outlive the data it points into.
concepts.context: the 'a on longest_line in lines.rs says the returned &str borrows from text

concepts.description: Returning a slice of the input avoids allocating a new String, at the price of the caller keeping the input alive.
concepts.context: longest_line returns Option<&str> rather than Option<String>, so nothing is copied

concepts.description: Option makes the empty case part of the type, so the caller has to handle it before using the value.
concepts.context: summarise in lines.rs matches on Some and None for an input with no lines
